node: Vertical AI software, proprietary data, and workflow automation
summary: Expanded the node universe around vertical AI software, proprietary data, and workflow automation. The reference lane is represented by Palantir as the high-attention enterprise/government operational-AI platform anchor. The underfollowed lane favors companies where AI is embedded into domain workflows: EXL in data/AI-led operations for insurance, healthcare, banking and utilities; Innodata in data engineering and AI operationalization services; and Vertex in indirect-tax compliance automation. Claims are intentionally conservative: product launches and customer/workflow claims are treated as facts when sourced, while durability of AI monetization, pricing power, and chokepoint status remain hypotheses for later layers.
